claim: When a game loads several events from tape with its own loader, embed all events in banks and use a small hook that copies the chosen event instead of reading tape.

evidence.text: Menu code reads each event with its own loader (0x627E -> ROM 0x0562) using a 22-byte flag-FF pseudo-header; the plain NEX holds events in banks 12-26 (5 pages each) with a 127-byte hook at 0x6C00; played on hardware (Downhill ran).
evidence.quote: The menu code (0x6000, `wispc0`) reads each event with its OWN loader (0x627E -> ROM 0x0562): a 22-byte flag-FF pseudo-header
